deployments_detail.use: 21 self-developed financial AI agents (AX Agent Summit 2026); AI red team for AX; group-wide financial AI transformation

Generative AI bank tellers ('AI Teller Kiosk') deployed at Digital Desks and Smart Kiosks in Shinhan Bank branches nationwide, handling routine teller tasks by voice (queue numbers, ID guidance, certificate printing, passbook copies, transaction history, account updates/closures). AI humans modeled on 5 real Shinhan employees using speech/video synthesis. [DeepBrain AI (AI Studios)]

Generative-AI 'Financial Knowledge Q&A Service' for Shinhan Bank employees, upgrading the internal chatbot with ChatGPT and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) drawing on 100,000+ financial data sources to answer complex financial inquiries. Described as a first in South Korea. [LG CNS (OpenAI ChatGPT + RAG)]

Group Integrated AI Contact Center (AICC) platform where AI-powered voice bots and chatbots respond to customer inquiries across group affiliates, sharing workload between human counselors and AI. [Shinhan Financial Group]

'Shinhan Super SOL' all-in-one finance app with embedded AI agents/assistant using natural language: users request ~50 financial services conversationally (e.g., 'How is Tesla stock performing?') across banking, card, securities, and insurance, preparing for 'agent-driven finance'. [Shinhan Financial Group]
'AI Investment Mate' investment-advice chatbot built on Shinhan Bank's proprietary large language model, showcased at CES and launched to customers. [Shinhan Bank (proprietary LLM)]
Fully staffless 'AI Branch' in central Seoul operating with AI avatar tellers and no human staff or business-hour restrictions. [Shinhan Bank / DeepBrain AI]

'AI Credit Extension Guardian' in the Shinhan SOL Securities app: AI analyzes daily risk factors for margin-funded stock positions (period returns, volatility, sector, market cap), issues real-time alerts on rising stock risk or credit-grade changes, replacing prior semi-annual risk assessments. [Shinhan Securities (in-house)]

Integrated 'One-Stop IPO Solution' AI agent for private-company clients (Shinhan Securities): analyzes corporate documents and recommends suitable relationship managers by expertise/experience; built by divisional employees on an in-house agent platform. [Shinhan Securities (in-house platform)]
Shinhan Card AI agent that automates the assessment/evaluation process for real-estate collateral (property-backed) loans. [Shinhan Card (in-house)]

AI 'red team' agent used at executive strategy events: analyzes executives' discussions in real time, generates counterarguments and alternative proposals, and provides feedback on assignments/presentations to improve objectivity of decision-making. [Shinhan Financial (in-house)]

'FAME' AI fraud-detection system deployed at Shinhan Card (first FAME customer): analyzes telecom + financial data (location, calls, texts, transactions) to detect and block voice phishing and smishing fraud patterns in real time. [SK Telecom (FAME)]
Shinhan Life internal-controls monitoring AI agent that examines social media posts to identify potential violations of internal compliance policies. [Shinhan Life (in-house)]

'AI PB' (AI Private Bank) personal investment assistant in the Shinhan SOL Securities app: provides personalized asset management, investment information and portfolio guidance to retail investors. [Shinhan Securities (in-house)]
